title: Finish PR #358 merge decision + backlog sweep (1hr timebox)
description:
# Northstar: finish PR #358 to merge-or-documented-block, then backlog sweep

## Mission (verbatim scope from the live conversation)
1. Complete the 4-seat /web-advice panel on https://github.com/jleechanorg/jleechan-skills/pull/358.
   - DONE, verified: Gemini APPROVED with notes (share URL https://gemini.google.com/share/2c9c287f4bfc?skid=2ac56d7b-093a-47a7-8315-832db22f55f0, curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -> 200).
   - DONE, verified: Grok APPROVED with notes (share URL https://grok.com/share/c2hhcmQtMw_37170ca6-b1b0-4899-bb6a-bb143fe29dbf, curl -> 200).
   - DONE: Perplexity CHANGES REQUESTED, medium confidence (share URL attempted, curl -> 403 even with browser UA; marked UNAVAILABLE per web-advice skill's mandatory rule, do NOT invent a working URL).
   - IN FLIGHT when interrupted: ChatGPT (tab already open at chatgpt.com, prompt already submitted, was mid-generation doing real repo clone + regex testing). Check its current state; if still generating, either wait once more (bounded, <=5 min) or, if the browser session is stale, treat as UNAVAILABLE with an honest note (do not fabricate a verdict).
2. Synthesize the panel per the web-advice skill's decision rule (3-of-4 agreement sufficient, or 2-of-4 from different families if strongly convergent). Current state: 2 APPROVED-with-notes (Gemini, Grok) vs 1 CHANGES REQUESTED (Perplexity) vs 1 pending/unknown (ChatGPT).
3. Run the /ready gate on PR #358: /es, /er, /advice already effectively covered this session (document-standards passes, fresh-eyes subagent review, aar triage) - explicitly re-verify current CI status via `gh pr checks 358` and `gh pr view 358 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus`, and confirm zero open review comments blocking merge.
4. Merge decision (autonomous, no user available):
   - The user's exact words: "merge approved once it passes and Pr is /ready" - this is a CONDITIONAL pre-authorization, valid ONLY if both the /web-advice panel and /ready gate genuinely pass.
   - If panel is 3-of-4+ non-REJECTED (APPROVED or APPROVED-with-notes counts as pass; CHANGES REQUESTED from exactly 1 seat with 3 others passing still counts as passing per the skill's 3-of-4 rule) AND /ready is green (CI green, no conflicts, no blocking comments): merge via `gh pr merge 358 --squash` (or whatever strategy matches repo convention - check existing merged PRs), citing this conditional approval verbatim in the merge commit/comment.
   - If NOT passing (e.g. 2-2 split, or /ready fails): do NOT merge. Instead: fix the specific blocking issues Perplexity/ChatGPT raised (if concrete and correct) with cheap parallel subagents, push a follow-up commit, re-run /ready, and re-attempt the merge decision ONCE more. If still not passing after one fix cycle, STOP attempting merge, leave the PR open with a clear status comment, and move to backlog work (step 5) for the remainder of the time-box.
   - Anti-gaming: do not talk yourself into merging on a technicality (e.g. don't discard Perplexity's CHANGES REQUESTED as "not a real seat" just because its share-URL probe failed - the verdict content itself is legitimate, captured from an authenticated session).
5. Remaining time budget: work the two deferred backlogs via /p (parallelize-to-ceiling) with cheap subagents, preferring in order: antigravity-cli subagent type > claudem (MiniMax wrapper, see ~/.bashrc) > plain general-purpose subagents:
   a. Restore some/all of the 380 remaining secret-redaction-corrupted (`[REDACTED_OPENAI_KEY]`) locations across ~50 files - use git history lookup per file where available (the pattern that worked for zfclevel.md), NOT a blind find-replace since corrupted text length varies per instance. Full list: `grep -rln REDACTED_OPENAI_KEY --include=*.md . | grep -v archive/`.
   b. Fix as many of the 71 remaining tier-2 /document-standards findings as can be safely, mechanically verified (13 high-severity ones listed in ~/roadmap/nextsteps-2026-08-23-jleechan-skills-tier2-ds-findings.md).
   Commit progress incrementally (small, scoped commits) on a NEW branch (do not add unrelated backlog work onto branch consolidate-command-archive-2026-08-23 if that PR already merged - if it merged, start fresh from main). Push and open a follow-up PR if enough work accumulates; do not force everything into one giant uncommitted pile.

## Hard constraints (from the live conversation, do not violate)
- 1-hour wall-clock hard stop from goal-set time. When time is nearly up, stop starting new work, commit/push whatever is in progress, and write a final status summary.
- No user available: never use AskUserQuestion, never wait on a response. Make the call yourself and document the reasoning.
- Never push directly to `main` - this repo's own CLAUDE.md requires PRs. Only `main` may receive a squash-merge of an already-passing PR.
- Never fabricate a share URL, a CI status, or a verdict that wasn't actually observed. If something can't be verified, say so explicitly (matches the whole session's "verify before reporting" discipline).
- Repo is jleechanorg/jleechan-skills (renamed from claude-commands this session) - both known local clones already have their remotes updated (~/projects_other/claude-commands and ~/.worktrees/claude-commands-export-fix).

## LLM-drift warnings for this exact session
- Do NOT declare "done" after only step 1-3 while skipping the actual backlog work in step 5 if time remains - the mission is not just "get the panel done", it's the full 5-step chain.
- Do NOT silently drop the Perplexity CHANGES REQUESTED verdict from the synthesis just because its share-URL failed to verify - that's a different failure mode (URL verification) than verdict validity (content was read from an authenticated session).
- Do NOT treat "merge approved once it passes" as unconditional merge authorization - it is explicitly conditional; verify both gates for real before merging.
- Do NOT keep polling the ChatGPT browser tab indefinitely if it's stuck - bound the wait, then move on with an honest note.
- Do NOT expand scope into unrelated repo work beyond the two named backlogs.
notes: MISSION COMPLETE within 1hr timebox (~36 min remaining at wrap-up). (1) PR #358 merged sha 79f4400, full panel synthesis posted. (2) Backlog (a): 214/324 redaction occurrences restored across 91 .md files, verified against git history, pushed as PR #359 (open, CI green, mergeable CLEAN - not auto-merged, out of scope for #358's specific conditional auth). (3) Backlog (b): tier-2 findings source list confirmed lost (never persisted before interruption) - did not fabricate; instead investigated PR #358's own 4 named example findings directly against the repo: 1 fixed (sidekick.md lane-naming contradiction, commit 3e9d26e0), 3 documented for follow-up (babysit collision needs product judgment, ao superseded-warning not reproduced, cmux-goal args not reproduced). Full writeup: ~/roadmap/nextsteps-2026-08-23-jleechan-skills-tier2-ds-findings.md. Next: user reviews/merges PR #359; a fresh /document-standards pass would be needed for the remaining ~67 tier-2 findings.

Token-health now reports PASS=8 FAIL=1 (AWS) SKIP=0; the bashrc abort is gone. The remaining FAIL is a separate env-var-not-set concern (AWS creds absent from this shell).
